question: Vishu is a _______ festival, celebrated primarily in the southern part of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindu.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vishu** is primarily celebrated in the southern Indian state of **Kerala** and marks the beginning of the **Malayalam New Year.**
 
• It is a **Hindu** festival.
 
• The festival is celebrated on the first day of the **Malayalam month of Medam** which usually falls in the month of **April.**
 
• The festival is celebrated with **great enthusiasm** and involves various rituals such as **Vishukkani, Vishukkaineetam, and Vishu Sadya.**
 
• The festival is also considered as a **harvest festival **and people offer prayers to the deity for a prosperous harvest season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buddhist festivals** are celebrated by followers of Buddhism and are primarily observed in countries where Buddhism is the major religion such as **Thailand, Sri Lanka, Myanmar, **etc.

 
 
• Some of the popular Buddhist festivals include **Vesak, Magha Puja, Asalha Puja**, etc.
 
 
 
• **Parsi festivals** are celebrated by followers of **Zoroastrianism** and are primarily observed in **Iran and India.**
 
 
• Some of the popular Parsi festivals include **Navroz, Khordad Sal, Mehregan**, etc.
 
 
 
• **Jain festivals** are celebrated by followers of** Jainism** and are primarily observed in India.
 
 
• Some of the popular Jain festivals include **Mahavir Jayanti, Paryushan Parva, Diwali,** etc.
